content.title: Faith Strengthened (Chizzuk Emunah)
content.author: Isaac ben Abraham of Troki (1533–1594) · translated by Moses Mocatta (London: printed by J. Wertheimer, 1851)
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: A Karaite Jewish scholar's reply, written in the 1590s, to the Old Testament texts Christians cite for Jesus, chapter by chapter (Isaiah 7:14 in chapter 21, Isaiah 52:13–53:12 in chapter 22, Micah 5:2 in chapter 33, Daniel 9 in chapter 42). For the Jewish reading in its own words. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator named and an exact locator.
